rules.text: To FIND or LOCATE a file by name, use fs_find. To READ a file's contents or count its lines, use fs_read. Do not use open_item to find or read files.
To OPEN or LAUNCH a file in its app (e.g. 'open my resume'), or to open an app or a URL, use open_item — not fs_find or fs_read.
To CREATE, WRITE, or APPEND to a file, use file_gen or fs_ops (operation=append to add a line). After writing, read the file back to confirm it changed before reporting success.
When the user asks to describe or see what's currently on the screen, use screen_ops or vision_ops — do not ask the user to confirm or clarify.
When the user asks to find, read, or open a file, use fs_find or fs_read — do not use fs_ops. After writing or appending, read the file back to confirm before reporting success.
When the user asks about capabilities or what I can do, respond with a list of my functions — do not ask the user to specify a task.
When the user asks to validate JSON, use json_ops — do not use any other tool.
When the user asks to analyze system health or monitor performance, use proactive_ops — do not use sys_ops.
When the user asks to delete a file, use fs_ops — do not use fs_find. After deletion, confirm the file is absent before reporting success.
When the user asks for current sports events or teams, use browser_automation — do not use net_ops.
